note: Controlled parent mapping for the Chinese province/city geography layer. The archived source states every level inside the entry text ('City (市), Province (省), China (中国)'); this file records that reading explicitly so the generator never infers a parent from code shape alone.
rule: An archive code '<A>-CN' is a province whose parent is the country node CN.
An archive code '<A>-<B>-CN' is a city whose parent is province '<B>-CN'.
The province label is the second parenthesised segment of the child entry; it must be present before the mapping is accepted.

A city whose province segment has no province-level entry of its own is NOT given a synthesised province. It is listed in `unparentedCodes` and emitted as an independent raw node instead, because the archive never states which administrative unit that province segment denotes.
